metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description: rule to create tickets for compliance failures
properties.query:
let Recommendations = 
    SecurityRecommendation
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecommendationName;
SecurityRegulatoryCompliance
| join kind=fullouter Recommendations on RecommendationName
| where ComplianceStandard in ("NIST-SP-800-53-R5", "CIS-Azure-Foundations-v2.0.0")
| where State == "Failed"
| where RecommendationState == "Unhealthy"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RecommendationName
| extend Affected_Resource = parse_json(tostring(Properties1.resourceDetails)).resourceName
| project
    RecommendationName,
    Description,
    RecommendationState,
    State,
    RecommendationSeverity,
    RecommendationLink,
    Affected_Resource

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat:
Severity:: {{RecommendationSeverity}} affecting resource:: {{Affected_Resource}}  
Investigate and remediate using {{RecommendationLink}} for further information.
